description: MinCryo aims to develop a compact, high-stability, closed-cycle cryo-microscope module for integration into commercial microscopes.

founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Junior Professor at the Institute of Applied Physics, University of Bonn.

funding_summary: ERC Proof of Concept Grant: €150,000 over one year, awarded in January 2026.
inflection_why_now: The increasing importance of cryogenic optical microscopy in bioimaging, photonics, semiconductor research, and quantum technology underscores the timely relevance of MinCryo's innovation.
devils_advocate_risks: Technical challenges in integrating cryogenic conditions into standard microscopes.
Market adoption hurdles due to the specialized nature of cryogenic microscopy.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Their focus on advanced materials and chemical technologies aligns with MinCryo's development of cryogenic microscopy modules.
Their interest in innovative technologies for biomedical research complements MinCryo's applications in bioimaging.
